item.seals.sealing_scroll.tooltip: Right-click a weakened mob to seal it inside you
message.seals.already_sealed: You already carry %s sealed inside you
message.seals.too_strong: %s is too strong: bring its health down to %s%% or less
message.seals.sealed_hint: Press U to see the bond and Alt for combat mode
message.seals.seal_broken: The seal broke! %s has been freed
message.seals.ability_passive: %s is passive: it is always active
screen.seals.title: Bond
screen.seals.combat_hint: Press %s to enter combat mode and use keys 1-9
ability.seals.manto_ferruquimico.desc: Your skin is covered in shiny grey iron. You gain a lot of armor and nothing can knock you back. Press its key to put it on or take it off.
ability.seals.pies_de_hierro.desc: When you fall from great heights, your feet turn to metal as you land and you take no damage.
ability.seals.yo_soy_el_golem.desc: You become a bigger creature while keeping your skin. You gain armor and your bare-handed punches hit much harder and launch enemies into the air. Can be combined with the Ferrous Mantle.
ability.seals.holy_golem.desc: Summon the blue spirit of a golem that fights by your side. It is faster than a normal golem, can jump and attacks whoever attacks you. Press again to dismiss it.
info.seals.bond.title: About the bond
info.seals.bond.hint: Hover over the stars, affinity, stability or age to see how they work.
info.seals.stars.title: Affection level
info.seals.stars: Every time affinity reaches 100, affection goes up a level and you earn a star. This mob has %s stars (max level %s).
info.seals.affinity.title: Affinity
info.seals.affinity: Goes from 0 to 100 and rises with small actions the sealed mob likes. At 100 you earn a star. Every year the mob ages gives +70.
info.seals.stability.title: Seal stability
info.seals.stability: Starts at 100. Doing things the mob hates lowers it. At 0 the seal breaks and the mob is freed to attack you.
info.seals.age.title: Age
info.seals.age: When sealed it was between %s and %s years old. Each Minecraft day is a month and every 12 days a year. Each year increases damage, duration of transformations and effects, and the health of its summons.
info.seals.age.bonus: At %s years old, its abilities have +%s%% power.
seal.seals.iron_golem.bond: You carry the spirit of an Iron Golem, guardian of villages. It is strong and loyal, but it cannot stand harm being done to its own.
seal.seals.iron_golem.affinity: The golem likes: trading with villagers (+1), killing hostile mobs (+1), defeating a boss (+50) and you using its abilities (+1 every minute).
seal.seals.iron_golem.stability: The golem is angered by: killing villagers (-10), players (-20) or allies such as your pets, iron golems or teammates (-5). If the seal breaks, a furious golem with double health comes out.
